title: Recipe A Phase 2 pre-registration and user decisions
decided_by: user, chat 2026-10-27; recorded before any OOF, seed, calibration or ensemble result was opened

phase2_rules_confirmed_by_user.deadline_timezone: unconfirmed; plan to upload no later than 2026-11-12
phase2_rules_confirmed_by_user.input: one image per case, identical to Phase 1

revised_calendar.10/27-10/29: seed46 OOF, seeds 47/48, green specialist + detector features, T4-bound inference dry run
revised_calendar.10/30-11/01: OOF comparison, calibration LOFO, TTA check, ensemble-vs-historical decision by the rule below, green stacking
revised_calendar.11/02-11/04: full-data (8954 minus 2 zero rows) SSL5 + 3 seed regressions, CUDA 12.x container, local end-to-end test
revised_calendar.11/08-11/09: limited repairs; architecture and preprocessing frozen 11/09

decisions.recipe: Recipe A (std pooling) is the Phase 2 single-model candidate (experiments/recipe_A_20261027/decision.json)
decisions.ensemble: Recipe A members differ only by regression seed (46, 47, 48); SSL seed 1003 fixed; equal-weight average of decoded predictions; no CPSAM members, no hybrid
decisions.tta: Four H/V flips, averaged in standardized-log space within a member, exactly as training augmentation; adopted only if its OOF delta is not positive (does not worsen) — measured before inclusion
decisions.calibration: Per-target scalar multipliers, MAPE-optimal weighted median as in Phase 1; benefit estimated leave-one-fold-out on OOF; final multipliers fitted on all five folds; adopted only if LOFO delta <= 0
decisions.full_data_fit: 8954 audited rows minus the two zero-HEX rows (2019-0064-ODCN/OSCN); SSL uses all 8954; option (가)
decisions.seed_sensitivity: Report per-fold spread over regression seeds 46/47/48 and per-seed OOF alongside the seed-average OOF; SSL-seed variation not run unless requested after 10/29
decisions.green: Continue until the deadline; enters the submission only through the same >=0.03pp two-fold gate; leaked rows (point_labels_seen) excluded from stacker fit and evaluation
decisions.t4: No T4 available; H200 dry run with 15 GiB allocator cap, fp16, flash/cudnn SDPA disabled; first official submission is the real T4 check

ensemble_vs_historical_rule.comparison_rows: matched1778 rows scored by both the historical calibrated six and recipe A OOF (phase2_pooling_20261020/ensemble_matched_comparison.json basis)
ensemble_vs_historical_rule.candidate: recipe A 3-seed ensemble with TTA/calibration only if each passed its own gate above
ensemble_vs_historical_rule.reference: historical six-member ensemble with fixed Phase 1 calibration (validation-selected checkpoints; optimistic for the reference)
ensemble_vs_historical_rule.rule: If candidate mean MAPE <= reference mean MAPE on the matched rows, submit the recipe A ensemble as submission 1. Otherwise submit the Phase 1 package as submission 1 and keep the recipe A ensemble as the submission-2 candidate.
ensemble_vs_historical_rule.uncertainty: Paired cluster bootstrap over id-prefix groups (10,000 resamples) of the per-image difference; report the 95% interval and P(candidate < reference) next to the point decision. The point rule decides; the interval is reported, not used to flip the decision.
ensemble_vs_historical_rule.component_guardrail: Any CD/CV/HEX worse by >0.05pp is flagged for explicit review before upload
ensemble_vs_historical_rule.no_post_hoc_changes: This rule is not edited after results are opened

pooling_evidence_addendum: Paired cluster bootstrap per pair and pooled over the four pairs (experiments/phase2_pooling_replication_20261026/bootstrap.json) is attached to the recipe A evidence; it does not re-open the recipe decision
known_limitations_to_state_in_any_report: Development folds historically reused; recipe choices were made on folds inside the OOF; OOF is optimistic
Patient independence and near-duplicate leakage unresolved; bootstrap groups are id prefixes, not verified patients
H200 dry run is not T4 certification
